title: SessionVault interchange document, version 1
description: One JSON document that carries either a whole vault (kind "vault") or exactly one session (kind "session"). Written and read by the SessionVault web app; the Apple app is expected to gain the same export and import later. Rules that a schema cannot express (id uniqueness, index order, hash checks, merge behaviour) are in data-model.md, section 'Interchange format, version 1'. Unknown properties are allowed on every object and must be preserved by readers that store and re-export the data. Property names starting with "x_" are reserved for app-specific extensions and will never be given a standard meaning.

format.description: Fixed marker that identifies the file type. Readers must check it before anything else.

version.description: Major version. Additive changes keep the value 1. A reader that sees a larger number must refuse the file with a clear message and must not import part of it.

kind.description: "vault": every project and every session of one vault at the time of export. "session": exactly one session, plus its project when it has one. Import is always a merge; a session or project that is absent from a "vault" document is never deleted at the destination.

projects.description: Projects referenced by the sessions in this document. A "vault" document also lists projects that have no sessions.

uuid.description: UUID in canonical form: 36 characters, lower-case hexadecimal, any UUID version. Swift's UUID.uuidString is upper-case and must be lower-cased by the exporter. Readers should accept upper-case input and lower-case it before comparing.

timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, RFC 3339 with the literal suffix Z and an optional fraction of 1 to 9 digits. Writers should emit exactly three fraction digits (milliseconds). Readers must accept both forms.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes, 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.

generator.description: Which program wrote the document. Informational only.

name.description: Display name, not empty after trimming white space.

updated_at.description: Last change to the project. When absent, readers use created_at.

title.description: May be empty (the Apple app allows it); apps display an empty title as "Untitled".

provider.description: Which assistant the conversation came from. Open list. Known values: "claude", "chatgpt", "gemini", "other". Any other value is kept as written and behaves like "other".

model.description: Free-text model label, empty when unknown. Informative examples: "claude-opus-5", "claude-fable-5-1", "claude-fable-5", "claude-sonnet-5", "claude-haiku-4-5". Never validated against a list.

source_url.description: The link the session was captured or pulled from, empty when there is none.

summary.description: Free text, may contain line breaks, empty when there is none.

tags.description: Ordered. Each tag is trimmed, lower-case, not empty, without commas, and appears once.

created_at.description: The ORIGINAL date of the conversation ("Original date" in the Apple app; user-editable). This is NOT the time the record was created in a database.

imported_at.description: When the session first entered a vault. Never changes afterwards, also not when the session moves between apps. Default list order is by this field.

updated_at.description: Last change to the session or to its message list. When absent, readers use imported_at.

project_id.description: Id of an entry in the document's projects array, or null.

attachments.description: Every binary object this session refers to: the page snapshot and anything referenced from message segments.

messages.description: In conversation order. messages[i].index must equal i.

attachment.description: Describes one binary object by content hash. The bytes travel inline (data_base64), or as the entry blobs/<sha256> of a ZIP bundle, or not at all.

kind.description: Open list. Known values: "original_pdf" (pixel-faithful PDF of the captured page, at most one per session), "image", "file", "other". Any other value is kept as written and behaves like "other".

media_type.description: IANA media type in lower case without parameters, for example "application/pdf" or "image/png".

filename.description: Suggested file name for downloads. No path separators.

data_base64.description: The raw bytes in standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4) with padding and without line breaks. Optional.

index.description: Zero-based position in the session. Equal to the position in the messages array.

role.description: Open list. Known values: "user", "assistant", "system", "unknown" (text with no identified speaker, shown as "Note"). Any other value is kept as written and behaves like "unknown".

segments.description: The content, in order. At least one segment. Two text segments never follow each other directly.

created_at.description: When this message was written, if known. Absent for imported transcripts.

model.description: Model id that produced this message when it was generated through the app's own API call. Absent otherwise.

segment.description: One part of a message. Open list of types. Known types: "text" and "attachment". A segment of any other type is kept as written, is left out of the flattened text, and is shown as a placeholder.

text.description: Markdown source exactly as stored, may be empty. Fenced code blocks stay inside this text; they are split out when the message is displayed.

sha256.description: Must match the sha256 of an entry in the attachments array of the same session.
